purpose: Declare how abyss-machine public seed contracts, release bundles, runtime artifacts, local evidence, and public media exports are fingerprinted, attested, or signed without publishing private host state.

abi_signature.meaning: A deterministic digest over tracked source files that define a public contract surface. It is a compatibility signal for agents and canaries, not a cryptographic release signature.

lineage_mapping.entity: the generated fact, report, trace, snapshot, session packet, or host evidence object
lineage_mapping.activity: the command, timer, service, or agent action that produced it
lineage_mapping.agent: the local tool, service, human operator, or agent session responsible for the activity

consumer_checks: schema and artifact_class match the expected local evidence contract
schema_ref resolves to the public local provenance packet schema
authority_ref resolves to /etc/abyss-machine or the nearest local route card
contract_version matches the local packet schema and policy contract expected by the consumer
producer_command or service identity is present
privacy_boundary forbids public publication unless reviewed
content_identity is present before cleanup, promotion, or export decisions
verification names the local validator or restore/probe check used by the consumer
promotion_controls: public export requires privacy review and a new public artifact identity
release signing requires conversion to a publishable artifact class
cleanup decisions require restore, usage, or quarantine evidence rather than age or path alone

release_export_triggers: public seed or bootstrap release is cut
host-managed runtime, AI runtime, extension, or install bundle is built
host-local evidence is promoted into durable registry
privacy-reviewed host material becomes public media
consumer_expectations: agents, installers, runtimes, and update clients consume only after durable registry promotion and trust-gate verdict
host-local evidence stays private until converted to a reviewed public artifact class
GitHub Actions/OIDC is only a release producer adapter; OS Abyss host trust-gates remain authoritative for local consumption
owner_boundaries: owns host enforcement, durable registry, trust gates, trust roots, update lane, and public bootstrap seed
does not own sibling repo doctrine, private workspace state, or abyss-stack runtime source truth

release_export_triggers: wheel or sdist is built
SDK package is published or handed to an installer/runtime consumer
non-publishing SDK routing G5 candidate is assembled for stronger-owner trust and runtime canary review
exact SDK routing G5 release candidate is prepared as a public GitHub release asset before owner switch
receipt-bound SDK routing G5 canonical bundle is published for owner-routed runtime consumption
consumer_expectations: package consumers verify wheel/sdist digest, SBOM, provenance, ABI identity, and trust-gate verdict before use
routing candidate consumers require the exact SDK source ref, candidate provenance, subject digest, and stronger-owner admission before an isolated or live canary
routing release consumers bind the exact public asset and release-ready registry record while normal runtime remains denied until the explicit canonical policy switch
routing runtime consumers require the exact v0.8.0 canonical archive, owner-switch receipt, public release evidence, materialized subject store, and normal-runtime trust-gate allow
owner_boundaries: aoa-sdk owns typed SDK/API package truth and, from the receipt-bound G5 switch, canonical routing generation; abyss-machine records evidence and gates consumption without rewriting SDK source

aoa-routing remains a maintenance-only compatibility, security, rollback, and deprecation predecessor; repository archival remains forbidden without consumer-zero, compatibility exit, and separate exact operator approval

release_export_triggers: runtime config bundle is rendered
deployable config bundle is exported or released
content-addressed external Codex actor runtime is materialized for machine-local canary activation
consumer_expectations: runtime consumers verify rendered config digest, SBOM-lite inventory, render provenance, source boundary, and trust-gate verdict

external actor runtime canaries verify the exact content-addressed release manifest, source ref, signed subject inventory, host-managed trust root, materialized subject, and fresh runtime_canary trust-gate verdict before activation
owner_boundaries: abyss-stack owns runtime/deployable stack source truth; abyss-machine may consume read-only evidence and enforce host gates

release_export_triggers: derived JSON readmodel is exported
public PDF, visualization, image, or other media export is published

deferred_records.reason: Tree-of-Sophia generated readmodels do not produce C2PA sidecars; public_media_export applies only after an owner-selected public PDF, visualization, image, or media export exists and must not be claimed as production C2PA before that route is real.

consumer_expectations: orientation consumers verify generated readmodel digests and source-first boundary; media consumers verify C2PA before public use
owner_boundaries: Tree-of-Sophia authored meaning remains stronger than generated readmodels; abyss-machine gates artifacts but does not become ToS doctrine

release_export_triggers: seed route readmodel is generated
public seed pack, media, PDF, or doc export is published

deferred_records.reason: Dionysus generated seed route readmodels do not produce C2PA sidecars; public_media_export applies only after an owner-selected public seed pack, PDF, media, or doc export exists and must not be claimed as production C2PA before that route is real.

consumer_expectations: seed consumers verify generated route-map digest and owner boundary; public media/seed packs require content credentials when published
owner_boundaries: Dionysus owns seed meaning and planting route; generated maps are navigation, not canonical seed authority

release_export_triggers: eval report/result index is generated
public PDF/media report is published

deferred_records.reason: aoa-evals generated report indexes do not produce C2PA sidecars; public_media_export applies only after an owner-selected public PDF/media report exists and must not be claimed as production C2PA before that route is real.

owner_boundaries: aoa-routing owns navigation metadata only; it does not become sibling source truth

owner_boundaries: aoa-playbooks owns scenario/playbook metadata; it does not become memory, proof, routing, or runtime authority

consumer_expectations: workspace and agent installers verify portable bundle digest, SBOM-lite inventory, export provenance, and trust-gate verdict; raw sessions never become trust authority
owner_boundaries: .aoa provides session evidence, routing, and rehydration; it is not OS trust law or policy authority

consumer_checks: verify the contract ABI generated/contract_abi_signatures.min.json is current before release
match the artifact class ABI epoch and source tree hash against the expected contract surface
parse the SBOM sidecar as SPDX or CycloneDX before trusting it
verify the SBOM artifact digest or component identity matches the release artifact
parse the ML-BOM sidecar as CycloneDX before trusting an AI bundle
verify model, dataset, conversion, framework config, and source digests are present for distributed AI artifacts
verify the SLSA/in-toto attestation subject digest matches the release artifact
verify predicateType, builder identity, canonical source, buildType, and expected externalParameters before install
verify the Sigstore/Cosign signature or bundle against the release artifact digest
verify signer identity, issuer or key root, and required annotations before trusting a release asset
verify the C2PA manifest or sidecar for public media/content exports
verify claim signature, active asset binding, accepted trust-list credential or explicit pre-organization onboarding warning, and privacy review route before publication

release_artifact_rules.external_signing_note: Mozilla extension signing is separate from Sigstore/Cosign release asset signing.

implementation_order: validate this policy in source-fast CI
publish ABI signatures as a deterministic generated read model
require local provenance packets for promoted host-local evidence
add release-time SBOM and minimal SLSA/in-toto provenance for built artifacts
add ML-BOM when AI model/runtime bundles are distributed
add Sigstore/Cosign only when release assets, blobs, or OCI artifacts exist
add C2PA only for public media/content exports
verify updateable/installable artifacts through the OS Abyss TUF-style update lane before update-client consumption

tuf.required_when: artifact is consumed by update_client, installer auto-update, package updater, runtime updater, or browser/tool update route
client_checks: metadata version is monotonic against previous trusted state
snapshot_version is monotonic against previous trusted state
timestamp_version is monotonic against previous trusted state
unchanged metadata cannot exceed max_freeze_seconds since previous trusted state
artifact trust-gate must still allow or warn for the target artifact before consumption

checks: role metadata exists and has matching _type
role versions are positive and monotonic against previous trusted state
role expires values are in the future
root role thresholds are satisfied by cryptographically valid Ed25519 signatures from declared keyids
repository root matches an out-of-band trusted root for client bootstrap or satisfies root rotation checks
root rotation verifies the new root through both old-root and new-root Ed25519 thresholds
targets, snapshot, and timestamp role signatures verify against root-delegated Ed25519 keys
timestamp references snapshot by version, length, and sha256
snapshot references targets by version, length, and sha256
targets binds target path by length and sha256
unchanged timestamp metadata cannot exceed max_freeze_seconds
artifact trust-gate must still allow or warn when update-client admission is required

cryptographic_signature_verifier.signed_payload: canonical JSON of the role signed object

external_repository_producer.command: abyss-machine artifacts update-repo-build REPOSITORY --target-file TARGET_FILE --target-path TARGET --artifact-class ARTIFACT_CLASS --key-dir KEY_DIR --json
external_repository_producer.key_route: host-managed Ed25519 key directory for production; --dev-generate-keys is local proof only

tuf.claim_limit: This is the OS Abyss external TUF repository producer/verifier v1: it builds root/targets/snapshot/timestamp metadata, verifies Ed25519 role thresholds, client bootstrap, rollback/freeze/expiry, target binding, and trust-gate admission. Public-channel key custody and ceremony remain host/operator production policy, not repo-embedded secrets.

scitt.trigger: signed statement federation exists across OS Abyss issuers or an external transparency service is introduced
scitt.required_when: external relying parties require append-only transparency receipts for OS Abyss signed statements

external_relying_party_mode.binding: receipt.statement_digest must equal canonical signed statement digest
external_relying_party_mode.registry_link_required: statement subject must bind to an existing durable artifact registry record when external relying-party mode requires registry linkage

scitt.claim_limit: SCITT is implemented as an OS Abyss local verifier/stub for statement/receipt binding and fail-closed external relying-party mode; live external transparency service, COSE signature verification, and Merkle receipt verification remain future production layers.

tuf.trigger: full external TUF repository, delegated signing keys, or distribution channel metadata exists
tuf.reason: OS Abyss v1 has a TUF-style update metadata gate, but no external delegated TUF repository or key ceremony is declared yet

scitt.trigger: signed statement federation exists across OS Abyss issuers
scitt.reason: local and release attestations do not yet require a federated transparency receipt plane
